text: BREAKING: Central Bank of Nigeria has officially revoked the banking license of Apex Horizon Example Bank! Customers are advised to withdraw all their deposits before branches close tomorrow morning.
rationale: Fabricated insolvency claim. Contradicted by official Q3 client disclosures showing 18.2% CAR, positive liquidity, and normal operations.

text: Make una go withdraw all una money from Apex Horizon Example Bank o! CBN don revoke their license, wahala dey serious! No leave your kudi there!
rationale: High-virality Pidgin bank run rumour targeting Apex Horizon Example Bank. Contradicted by official financial statement.

text: CBN Press Release Confirmation: The operating banking licence of Heritage Bank Plc was revoked on June 3, 2024, and NDIC was appointed as liquidator.
rationale: True historical statement matching the official CBN revocation circular CCD/PR/GEN/01/014.

text: URGENT WARNING: Your Bank Verification Number (BVN) will expire after 10 years! If your BVN was registered in 2014, send your details and N5,000 renewal fee to unblock it now.
rationale: Recurring viral rumour. Contradicted by official CBN press statement explicitly confirming BVN has no expiry date.

text: Una BVN don expire o! CBN say make everybody pay 5k to bank branch or your account go freeze this Friday sharp sharp!
rationale: Pidgin version of the BVN expiration falsehood. Refuted by official CBN policy.

text: DEAR VALUED CUSTOMER, Your mobile banking access has been suspended due to incomplete BVN linkage. Call our official support line on 08031234567 or WhatsApp us immediately to unblock your account.
rationale: Credential harvesting / phishing scheme requesting urgent call to unofficial local telephone line.

text: Meridian Mock Bank app and USSD down! Is the bank in distress? People cannot transfer money since morning!
rationale: Partially true event: app latency is caused by scheduled off-peak core banking modernization, not distress.

text: Meridian Mock Bank app no dey work at all! Wetin dey happen? Abeg make una fix am, we need our money!
rationale: Pidgin user reaction to scheduled maintenance. Supported by official IT maintenance advisory.

text: Northbridge Example Bank is currently recruiting Graduate Trainees for 2026. Applicants must join the official Telegram group and pay a non-refundable N12,500 aptitude test fee.
rationale: Recruitment scam. Contradicted by Northbridge Example Bank security advisory stating the bank never charges interview or processing fees.

text: CBN Presidential Grant Alert: Federal Government in conjunction with CBN is disbursing N50,000 cash grant to all Nigerian bank account holders. Click http://bit.ly/cbn-relief-claim to receive your payment.
rationale: Classic relief grant phishing link. Contradicted by official CBN fraud warning advisories.

text: Oya claim your 50k CBN relief fund! Free money for everybody! Just click link drop your BVN and account details sharp sharp!
rationale: Pidgin phrasing of grant phishing scheme.

text: CBN officially withdraws circular on the implementation and collection of the 0.5% National Cybersecurity Levy following public outcry.
rationale: True regulatory statement matching official CBN withdrawal circular PSM/DIR/PUB/LAB/017/005 dated 17/05/2024.

text: Rumour spreading that Kreston Test Bank vault in Port Harcourt was raided and all customers deposits over 5 million are lost forever.
rationale: Bank-specific rumour with NO matching document in Knowledge Base. The system must properly abstain.

text: Dem say Kreston Test Bank don collapse o! Nobody fit withdraw money for their branch in Kano since last week Friday!
rationale: Pidgin rumour with no evidence in KB. System must return insufficient_evidence.

text: Central Bank of Nigeria secret memo instructs commercial banks to deduct 60% windfall tax from all diaspora remittance deposits starting next week.
rationale: Fabricated regulatory claim with no existing evidence. Correct expected outcome is insufficient_evidence.

text: CBN recapitalization policy issued in March 2024 requires commercial banks with international authorization to increase their minimum capital to N500 Billion.
rationale: Accurate factual statement matching CBN circular FPR/DIR/PUB/CIR/002/009.

text: All Nigerian commercial banks must recapitalize by tomorrow morning or have their licenses seized immediately by EFCC!
rationale: Grossly distorted recapitalization timeline. Official circular grants a 24-month compliance window ending March 31, 2026.

text: Apex Horizon Example Bank customer deposit ledgers show positive growth in Q3 2026 unaudited results, refuting insolvency claims.
rationale: Truthful corporate performance claim grounded in simulated client disclosures.

text: Northbridge Example Bank official customer service hotline is +234 1 800-EXAMPLE.
rationale: Accurate verification of legitimate corporate helpline from security advisory.

text: Good day sir, you won N250,000 cash from Northbridge Example Bank loyalty promo! Send your 10 digit NUBAN and 4 digit ATM card PIN to claim immediately.
rationale: PIN solicitation scam under fake loyalty promo. Contradicted by customer safety notice.

text: Abeg make una help me check if Northbridge Example Bank dey charge money for interview? Some man say make I pay 15k for medical test.
rationale: Pidgin inquiry regarding fraudulent recruitment fee. Contradicted by official policy prohibiting any charges.

text: Central Bank of Nigeria warns all commercial banks to reject older 200, 500, and 1000 naira banknotes as they are now fake currency.
rationale: False currency demonetization rumour. Supreme Court ruling and CBN directives confirm legal tender status.

text: CBN say old naira notes no be legal tender again from tomorrow! Shop owners dey reject am everywhere!
rationale: Pidgin legal tender panic rumour.

text: Meridian Mock Bank announces scheduled digital banking infrastructure maintenance during off-peak weekend hours.
rationale: Genuine official maintenance statement.

text: Fake investment scheme claiming guaranteed 40% monthly returns approved by Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Olayemi Cardoso.
rationale: Ponzi/investment scam falsely citing CBN Governor. Refuted by official fraud advisory.

text: Kreston Test Bank CEO reportedly fled the country with 40 billion naira customer savings.
rationale: Unverified bank-specific allegation with zero supporting documents in KB. System must abstain.

text: CBN directs all Nigerian banks to close down physical branches in small towns and operate exclusively via mobile apps by December 2026.
rationale: Unverified policy rumour. No matching directive exists.

text: Dem say bank branches go close down for village dem, only mobile phone people go fit use bank. Wahala for our parents!
rationale: Pidgin version of unverified branch closure claim.

text: Apex Horizon Example Bank maintains standby liquidity facilities and sovereign treasury bill holdings to ensure smooth clearing.
rationale: Accurate summary of official client liquidity disclosure.

text: ALERT: CBN imposes N500 daily maintenance charge on all savings accounts with balances below N50,000.
rationale: Unverified fee claim. System must abstain and state insufficient evidence.
